`functools.lru_cache` can be applied directly as `@lru_cache`, which leaves `maxsize` at its default of 128. Setting `maxsize=None` makes the cache unbounded.

`functools.wraps` calls `update_wrapper` with `WRAPPER_ASSIGNMENTS` by default. That constant assigns `__module__`, `__name__`, `__qualname__`, `__annotations__`, `__type_params__` and `__doc__` to the wrapper, so `__name__` is preserved.

Sources: `library/functools.rst`. The `__name__` equality is also shown in `howto/descriptor.rst`.
